ISSUE_KIND: streetlight
ISSUE: Damaged and missing luminaires on twin-arm street light
DETAILS: The photo shows the top portion of an ornamental twin-arm lamppost against the sun and blue daytime sky. The left luminaire is completely missing with exposed wires protruding, and the right arm has an exposed bulb without an enclosing globe or lantern casing. The user note is empty.
ORGANIZATION: New York City Department of Transportation
DEPARTMENT: Division of Traffic Operations
WHY: West 86th Street is a public municipal street within the Borough of Manhattan in New York City. The New York City Department of Transportation operates and maintains streetlights and lighting equipment on all city roadways and sidewalks.
